# Icon { #anylumino.Icon }

```python
Icon(icon='', *, icon_src='', icon_size='m', label='', **kwargs)
```

Display a Spectrum workflow icon.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name      | Type     | Description                                                                   | Default   |
|-----------|----------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------|
| icon      | optional | Spectrum workflow icon name.                                                  | `''`      |
| icon_src  | optional | Custom icon image URL or data URI.                                            | `''`      |
| icon_size | optional | Spectrum icon size such as ``'s'``, ``'m'``, ``'l'``, ``'xl'``, or ``'xxl'``. | `'m'`     |
| label     | optional | Accessible label or visible label, depending on the component.                | `''`      |
